skills.name: 3-statement-model
skills.description: Complete, populate and fill out 3-statement financial model templates (Income Statement, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow Statement) . Use when asked to fill out model templates, complete existing model frameworks, populate financial models with data, complete a partially filled IS/BS/CF framework, or link integrated financial statements within an existing template structure. Triggers include requests to fill in, complete, or populate a 3-statement model template
headings: ⚠️ CRITICAL PRINCIPLES — Read Before Populating Any Template
Formatting — Professional Blue/Grey Palette (Default unless template/user specifies otherwise)
skills.description_zh: 补齐现有三表财务模型模板的数据和公式，完善利润表、资产负债表、现金流量表，并在模板结构内建立报表关联。

skills.name: audit-xls
skills.description: Audit a spreadsheet for formula accuracy, errors, and common mistakes. Scopes to a selected range, a single sheet, or the entire model (including financial-model integrity checks like BS balance, cash tie-out, and logic sanity). Triggers on "audit this sheet", "check my formulas", "find formula errors", "QA this spreadsheet", "sanity check this", "debug model", "model check", "model won't balance", "something's off in my model", "model review".
skills.description_zh: 审计选定区域、单个工作表或完整模型的公式、错误和常见问题，包括财务模型资产负债平衡、现金勾稽和逻辑合理性检查。

skills.name: comps-analysis
skills.description:
Build institutional-grade comparable company analyses with operating metrics, valuation multiples, and statistical benchmarking in Excel/spreadsheet format.

**Perfect for:**
- Public company valuation (M&A, investment analysis)
- Benchmarking performance vs. industry peers
- Pricing IPOs or funding rounds
- Identifying valuation outliers (over/under-valued)
- Supporting investment committee presentations
- Creating sector overview reports

**Not ideal for:**
- Private companies without comparable public peers
- Highly diversified conglomerates
- Distressed/bankrupt companies
- Pre-revenue startups
- Companies with unique business models
headings: ⚠️ CRITICAL: Formulas Over Hardcodes + Step-by-Step Verification
Visual Convention Standards (OPTIONAL - User preferences and uploaded templates always override)
Optional Valuation Metrics (Choose based on context)
skills.description_zh: 生成 Excel/表格格式的可比公司分析，包含经营指标、估值倍数和统计对标，用于上市公司估值、并购、IPO/融资定价、异常估值识别及投委会/行业汇报；缺少公开可比对象的私企、多元集团、困境公司、未收入初创或独特模式公司不适合。

skills.name: dcf-model
skills.description: Real DCF (Discounted Cash Flow) model creation for equity valuation. Retrieves financial data from SEC filings and analyst reports, builds comprehensive cash flow projections with proper WACC calculations, performs sensitivity analysis, and outputs professional Excel models with executive summaries. Use when users need to value a company using DCF methodology, request intrinsic value analysis, or ask for detailed financial modeling with growth projections and terminal value calculations.
headings: Step 7: Discount Rate Application (5-10 Year Forecast)
Step 9: Enterprise to Equity Value Bridge
Scenario Block Selection Pattern - Follow This Approach
skills.description_zh: 根据 SEC 披露和分析师报告建立企业 DCF 估值模型，预测现金流、计算 WACC 与终值、开展敏感性分析，输出含管理层摘要的 Excel 模型。

skills.name: deck-refresh
skills.description: Updates a presentation with new numbers — quarterly refreshes, earnings updates, comp rolls, rebased market data. Use whenever the user asks to "update the deck with Q4 numbers", "refresh the comps", "roll this forward", "swap in the new earnings", "change all the $485M to $512M", or any request to swap figures across an existing deck without rebuilding it.
headings: Phase 3 — Present the plan, get approval
skills.description_zh: 在现有演示稿中替换更新数字，适用于季度数据、业绩、可比公司和重新定基市场数据刷新，保持原有演示结构而不重建整套稿件。

skills.name: ib-check-deck
skills.description: Investment banking presentation quality checker. Reviews a pitch deck or client-ready presentation for (1) number consistency across slides, (2) data-narrative alignment, (3) language polish against IB standards, (4) visual and formatting QC. Use whenever the user asks to review, check, QC, proof, or do a final pass on a deck, pitch, or client materials — including requests like "check my numbers", "reconcile figures across slides", "is this client-ready", or "what am I missing before I send this out".
skills.description_zh: 检查投行或客户演示稿的跨页数字一致性、数据与叙事对应、投行语言质量及视觉格式。适用于最终质检、数字核对、跨页对账或发送前确认材料是否就绪。

skills.name: lbo-model
skills.description: This skill should be used when completing LBO (Leveraged Buyout) model templates in Excel for private equity transactions, deal materials, or investment committee presentations. The skill fills in formulas, validates calculations, and ensures professional formatting standards that adapt to any template structure.
headings: CRITICAL INSTRUCTIONS FOR CLAUDE - READ FIRST
Fill Color Palette — Professional Blues & Greys (Default unless user/template specifies otherwise)
TEMPLATE ANALYSIS PHASE - DO THIS FIRST
skills.description_zh: 填充私募股权交易的 Excel LBO 模型模板，补充公式、验证计算，并按既有模板结构统一专业格式。

skills.name: pitch-deck
skills.description: Populates investment banking pitch deck templates with data from source files. Use when: user provides a PowerPoint template to fill in, user has source data (Excel/CSV) to populate into slides, user mentions populating or filling a pitch deck template, or user needs to transfer data into existing slide layouts. Not for creating presentations from scratch.
headings: Populating Investment Banking Pitch Deck Templates
Convert to images for visual validation
skills.description_zh: 将 Excel、CSV 等源文件数据填入现有投资银行推介 PowerPoint 模板，沿用既有幻灯片布局；不用于从零创建演示文稿。

skills.name: pptx-author
skills.description: Produce a .pptx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live PowerPoint document — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
skills.description_zh: 在没有打开 Office 应用的托管智能体环境中，以无界面方式直接生成磁盘上的 .pptx 文件。

skills.name: sector-overview
skills.description: Create comprehensive industry and sector landscape reports covering market dynamics, competitive positioning, key players, and thematic trends. Use for client requests, sector initiations, thematic research pieces, or internal knowledge building. Triggers on "sector overview", "industry report", "market landscape", "sector analysis", "industry deep dive", or "thematic research".
skills.description_zh: 生成行业与板块全景报告，覆盖市场动态、竞争定位、主要参与者和主题趋势，适用于客户研究、行业启动研究、专题分析与内部知识建设。

skills.name: xlsx-author
skills.description: Produce a .xlsx file on disk (headless) instead of driving a live Excel workbook — for managed-agent sessions with no open Office app.
skills.description_zh: 在没有打开 Office 应用的托管智能体环境中直接生成磁盘上的 .xlsx 文件，以无界面方式完成表格文件制作。
